sylvia: FYI: Nimbus Retail (acct NR-220) showing a sudden 46% drop in daily calls to the personalization endpoint. Renewal in 11 days; onboarding score 39/100.

kevin: ARR and renewal contact?

sylvia: $37k ARR. Renewal owner is tara@nimblenet.com. Missed follow-up + NPS 4. No billing issues but they reported guidance confusion on batching config.

mohit: Any error spikes or regressions?

sylvia: No error spikes. Support thread SUP-2120 about inconsistent embeddings similarity. Usage shifted to smaller payloads, likely due to cost concerns.

tara: Can we do a short activation pulse: one quick audit, a 30m joint workshop, and a reversible config patch? I want a 1-page I can send to their CTO.

kevin: Proposed quick play (owners inline):
```
- outreach + one-pager (owner: tara) within 12h
- 30m workshop: product+eng demo of batching & caching gains (owner: kevin)
- prompt/usage audit: identify top 3 token sinks (owner: mohit)
- reversible config patch (batching + KV prefix cache + prompt trim) with rollback script (owner: mohit)
- conditional offer: 21-day usage credit tied to completing the workshop and applying the patch (owner: kevin)
- escalation: no reply in 48h -> CSM lead (owner: tara)
```

sylvia: Please keep discounts off the table unless they insist. Focus on demonstrating value first.

mohit: I'll pull endpoint token distribution and a sample diff for the patch. Query I'll run: 
```
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens) as tokens, COUNT(*) as calls FROM usage.events WHERE account='NR-220' AND ts>now()-14d GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 8;
```

kevin: I'll draft the workshop slides with a small before/after token & latency table and a tiny migration checklist. We can show a reversible toggle so CTO sees low-risk change.

tara: I'll send outreach now and attach the one-pager. If they accept workshop, propose Mon/Tue slots. If they decline, prepare downgrade mapping doc showing exact feature delta.

cse_bot: Account snapshot added: https://redwood.app/account/NR-220/health | onboarding 39/100, last enablement 48d ago, NPS=4. Save-play artifact created and linked.

sylvia: Assigning owners: tara (outreach + exec one-pager), kevin (workshop deck + demo), mohit (audit + patch). I'll mark as high-touch and set a follow-up reminder in 36h.

kevin: Ack. Will post slide draft here when ready.

mohit: Posting preliminary audit notes by EOD; early signal: repeated metadata in requests and an overly verbose system prompt are the main token sinks. Simple dedupe + prompt shortener should cut tokens 15-25%.

sylvia: Thanks team. If we show measurable impact quickly we'll propose a renewal extension conditional on continued usage.

cse_bot: Reminder created: follow-up in 36h if no response.
